sentences: So, don't hesitate to discuss your preferences with your team lead.
Consistency is key in our codebases.
We adhere to PEP 8 style guidelines and encourage the use of type hints for better code readability and maintainability.
We also emphasize documentation, so be sure to include docstrings in your functions and classes.
As you work on your first tasks, don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or need guidance.
Now, as we continue to work together, I want to emphasize the importance of consistent coding practices.
Going forward, I'd like you to adopt a couple of specific practices.
First, I want you to end variable names with '_n'.
This is a convention we follow in our team to improve code readability and maintain consistency.
Secondly, I'd like you to always use annotations for functions.
This helps with code documentation and makes it clearer for other engineers to understand your code.
These practices will ensure that your code aligns with our team's standards and makes it easier for collaboration and knowledge sharing.
Don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or concerns about these instructions.
We're always here to support each other.
